up: Retrieve all activity records from the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4649962 that are exact measurements, meaning standard_relation equals '=' and standard_value is not null. For each such record, output the canonical SMILES of the compound, the molecule ChEMBL ID, the standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Ensure the results come from joining the assays table (filtered by chembl_id) with activities, then with molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to get the required compound identifiers and SMILES. Do not add any other filters (e.g., no unit restrictions, no confidence score filters) and return all matching rows without limiting the number.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649962' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
